# bifrost_member (Resource)

Una persona con permiso sobre una App. La App no puede quedarse sin owner (la API devuelve 409 al degradar o quitar al último).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bifrost_member" "ana" {
  app   = bifrost_app.tienda.name
  email = "ana@example.org"
  role  = "deploy"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String)
- `email` (String) Correo en minúsculas.
- `role` (String) `owner`, `deploy` o `readonly`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import bifrost_member.ana tienda/ana@example.org
```
